domain-information: A Reporter interviews local officials and witnesses to gather accurate information for a front-page story
A Reporter verifies facts and cross-checks sources to ensure the news is reliable before submission
An Editor reviews submitted articles to refine clarity, tone, and style for the newspaper’s audience
An Editor decides which stories make it to the front page to prioritize the most relevant news
A Layout Designer arranges articles, images, and advertisements on newspaper pages to create a readable layout
A Layout Designer adjusts spacing and font sizes to fit breaking news into the next edition
A Printer receives the final page layout and prints thousands of physical newspapers for the morning distribution
A Printer coordinates ink and paper supply to ensure production runs smoothly without delays
A Distribution Manager plans delivery routes to ensure newspapers reach stores, subscribers, and street vendors on time
A Distribution Manager tracks delivery performance and reports delays to the editorial team to adjust future logistics
A Subscription Coordinator processes new subscriptions to maintain a steady readership base
A Subscription Coordinator handles customer questions and updates addresses to ensure newspapers are delivered correctly

associations.description: Layout Designer builds the Newspaper Page Layout
Newspaper Page Layout places Article Submission
Layout Designer arranges the Article Submission
Layout Designer produces the Final Page Layout
Final Page Layout is delivered to the Printer
Style Review refines the Article Submission
Submission Approval confirms the Article Submission
Newspaper Copy goes to the Distribution Manager
Subscription Coordinator receives a Customer Question
Distribution Manager issues a Delay Report
Delay Report is sent to the Editorial Team
